review:
Mystery Heist is a 243-ways slot built around Sticky Mystery Prizes. Three scatters award 10 free spins, and four award 10 Super Free Spins. In both, the scatters turn into Sticky Mystery Prizes that stay locked for the whole round.

Prizes only reveal their values when four or more are on the reels, ranging from 0.1x to 20x the bet, plus four special prizes: Mini (25x), Minor (50x), Major (250x) and Grand. In Super Free Spins the minimum prize value is 1x instead of 0.2x. BGaming rates it medium-high volatility with a 2,000x maximum and an excellent 97.12% RTP.
pros: Excellent 97.12% RTP – among the highest published
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
